title: NetLicensing-MCP HTTP mode uses the server-side NetLicensing API key for unauthenticated requests (CVE-2026-54446)
summary: netlicensing-mcp (PyPI) through 0.1.5: in HTTP transport mode, ApiKeyMiddleware forwards requests that carry no client API key unconditionally, and the downstream HTTP client falls back to the server's own NetLicensing API key — unauthenticated remote callers act with the operator's full API privileges. Fixed in 0.1.6.
